title: Base ReadPropertyMultiple boundary-adjacent request
purpose: Exercise a somewhat larger confirmed-service request with nested property-list structure while keeping internal frame length consistency.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint may parse the frame as a multi-property read request and enter deeper confirmed-service and tagged-parameter handling paths than the simpler ReadProperty seed.
constraints_preserved: Common BACnet/IP-style BVLC plus NPDU plus APDU layering retained
BVLC four-byte total length is internally consistent
Length-boundary-valid objective preserved with a larger single request
issue_safety_notes: The frame shape is intentionally conservative and structurally richer for fuzzing utility, without relying on external documentation or making vulnerability assertions.
